messages:
maria_ng: Quick retrospective from the canary we ran this morning for speculative decode + 4-bit quant on titan-13b. saw ~28% p95 latency drop but ~1.9% absolute increase in instruction-following failures on the admin-eval cohort. writing notes here for follow-ups.
alex_ryan: ACK. can you paste the eval summary? rough numbers are fine.
samuel: curious if failures correlate with long prompts or stop-token handling (spec might commit earlier).
jin-ml: initial skim: regressions concentrated in the 'rewrite' suite (short, constrained outputs) not open-ended chat. feels like low-prob token distortion.
maria_ng: here's the quick CSV we dumped from the canary harness:
```csv
cohort,latency_p95_ms,latency_p50_ms,err_rate_instrfollow
baseline(amt),320,120,0.8%
spec+4bit,230,95,2.7%
spec-only,245,100,1.0%
4bit-only,310,118,1.3%
```
ops-bot: Canary deploy snapshot r-2026-03-15-011 succeeded on 8/10 shards ; 2 shards rolled back.
samuel: rollback shards showed higher mem pressure and ~15% more KV-cache evictions — maybe context pieces dropped and speculative commit used stale KV?
alex_ryan: did we change prefix caching order in this roll? prefetch ordering could change which KV entries are hot.
maria_ng: config used for the canary: `speculative.enabled=true`, `speculative.fill_ratio=0.6`, `speculative.early_abort=0.0`, `quant.level=4bit-q4`, `kv.cache_policy=lfu`.
jin-ml: I ran a small micro-holdout: with `fill_ratio=0.8` errors jump to 3.4% but p95 goes to 215ms. so it's a pretty steep tradeoff.
samuel: also saw seed sensitivity on the rewrite suite — same prompt, different RNG seeds flip correctness on ~0.4% of cases. worth checking sampling interplay.
alex_ryan: plausible hypothesis: 4-bit quant slightly biases logits; speculative prefetch commits tokens earlier based on biased logits => amplifies small shifts into wrong committed tokens.
maria_ng: Proposed next steps (short list):
- Run per-cohort A/B traces: spec+4bit vs 4bit-only, bucketed by prompt length (short/med/long)
- Re-run with `fill_ratio=0.3` and `early_abort=0.2` to test conservative commit
- Add targeted unit tests for the 'rewrite' suite with soft prompts / adversarial variants
- Instrument logits-delta histograms at the commit point and after quant kernel
- Try q8-emulation (q8) as intermediate quant level to see smoothness of regression

samuel: +1 on logits-delta histograms — that should show amplification. also add a per-token confidence delta metric.
jin-ml: I'll set up 2 holdouts w/ the harness: short (<256), medium (256-1024), long (>1024). estimate full run ~12h on 24 shards.
alex_ryan: add qualitative checks: simple edit-distance / BLEU-like for rewrites and an instruction-fidelity binary classifier we already have.
maria_ng: also creating a PR for the eval harness changes and config; draft PR #4123 (will link once pushed).
ops-bot: Scheduled job `spec-quant-holdout-175999` created by maria_ng. ETA ~14h.
samuel: small privacy note: when you add logs for the histograms, scrub user payloads and keep only token ids / meta.
maria_ng: yep will scrub. planning to post sanitized artifacts and a short summary here once runs finish.
jin-ml: pinging @samuel @alex_ryan for a quick code review on the histogram exporter (it's lightweight).

maria_ng: thanks all — aim to reconvene after the holdout completes.
